data.one_liner: Save byte data into the Download folder on Android or show a save dialog on iOS.
data.what_it_does: Saves single or multiple files from raw byte data directly to the device storage. Handles platform-specific actions such as accessing the Download folder on Android or opening the save dialog on iOS.
use_when: You need to save generated files like PDFs, text documents, or images from bytes.
You want to target Android's Download folder or trigger iOS file save dialogs.
avoid_when: You need a general file picker to read files rather than save them.
You require complex local file system management beyond saving binary payloads.
strengths: Supports saving both single and multiple files at once.
No storage permissions required on Android Q and above.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission for Android versions below Q.
Limited to saving byte arrays to downloads or showing save dialogs.
data.setup_notes: For Android target below Q, add the WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission in AndroidManifest.xml. No permissions needed for iOS.
